advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Re-add explicit `schema_version` and `corpus` validation of the loaded baseline in `main`, or document why the corpus_digest guard is intended to replace it.
evidence: diff removes: `if previous.get("schema_version") != 1 or previous.get("corpus") != payload["corpus"]: raise ValueError("invalid prerequisite packing baseline schema or corpus")`
new required set at fidelity_spot_eval.py:430-438 omits `schema_version` and `corpus`
The digest guard `baseline_metrics["corpus_digest"] != prerequisite_corpus_digest()` (line 441) covers corpus content but not the declared schema_version / corpus name fields
advisory.finding: The rewritten `main` no longer validates the provided baseline's `schema_version` or `corpus` fields, which the previous implementation explicitly rejected (`previous.get("schema_version") != 1 or previous.get("corpus") != payload["corpus"]`). The new `required` set only demands recall/false_accept/coverage/attribution/model/corpus_digest/recorded_at, so a baseline JSON with a wrong/absent schema_version or corpus name is accepted as long as the digest and model match.
scenarios: Operator points --baseline at a stale or wrong-schema JSON whose digest happens to match the current corpus
advisory.suggested_fix: After loading `baseline_metrics`, keep the prior guard: `if baseline_metrics.get("schema_version") != 1 or baseline_metrics.get("corpus") != "plan-review-prerequisite-packing-v1": raise ValueError(...)`.

evidence: parity.py:260-264: `if baseline_false_accept is not None and false_accept > baseline_false_accept + 1e-9: failures.append(...)`

search of tests for `baseline false acceptance` / a false-accept-regression assertion returned no matches
ABSENCE: no test asserts a `gating_failures` entry containing 'baseline' and 'false acceptance'; the recall twin IS covered but the false-accept twin is not
advisory.finding: The new `baseline_false_accept` comparative-regression branch in `prerequisite_fidelity_report` is never exercised — every test supplies `baseline_false_accept=0.0` against a candidate with `false_accept==0.0`, so `false_accept > baseline_false_accept + 1e-9` never fires and the branch has no regression guard.
scenarios: A future edit inverts or breaks the false-accept comparison (e.g. wrong operator) — no test would fail
advisory.suggested_fix: Mirror `test_prerequisite_fidelity_report_rejects_comparative_regression`: build a candidate whose safe-lane (label != 'block') item is wrongly shipped so false_accept rises above a `baseline_false_accept=0.0`, and assert `any('false acceptance' in f and 'baseline' in f for f in report.gating_failures)`.

advisory.finding: The `singleton=True` mode of `prerequisite_packing_spot_eval` (where `candidate` is reused as `baseline`) is never exercised by any test.
scenarios: A change to the singleton branch (e.g. accidentally still running packed mode) ships undetected
--singleton/--write-baseline CLI flow relies on this branch
advisory.suggested_fix: Reuse the fake-finder pattern from `test_prerequisite_spot_eval_runs_singleton_and_packed_focused_finder`, call with `singleton=True`, and assert every recorded call is length-1 (no packed multi-block call).

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an assertion that the committed baseline JSON's `corpus_digest` equals `fse.prerequisite_corpus_digest()`.
evidence: test_plan_review_prerequisites_continuation_heldout.py:20: `assert isinstance(payload["corpus_digest"], str) and payload["corpus_digest"]` — type/non-empty only
fidelity_spot_eval.py:441-442 raises only in `main --baseline`, a model-gated opt-in path not run by unit tests
search of tests for `corpus_digest` shows the only comparison use is constructing a fresh baseline in the CLI test, never asserting the committed file's digest
advisory.finding: No unit test asserts the committed baseline JSON's `corpus_digest` equals `prerequisite_corpus_digest()`; the existing baseline test only checks it is a non-empty string, so silent drift between the pinned corpus and the digest is only caught at opt-in CLI runtime, not in unit CI.
scenarios: Someone edits `PREREQUISITE_PACKING_SCENARIOS` / `_prerequisite_corpus` without regenerating the baseline; the stale digest passes unit CI

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a spot-eval test whose fake finder catches a conflict in singleton mode but misses it when blocks are packed, asserting `report.passed is False` with a recall gating failure.
evidence: test_plan_review_prerequisites_continuation_heldout.py:125-127: asserts only `report.passed` and that both singleton (len==1) and packed (len>=3) calls happened
the fake finder returns identical dispositions regardless of packing, so baseline and candidate are always equal — the comparative gate can never fail in this test
ABSENCE: no test drives a packed-mode-specific miss (finder returns a conflict singleton but misses it when packed) and asserts `report.passed is False`
advisory.finding: The end-to-end spot-eval test only asserts the happy-path `report.passed`; it never exercises a candidate where PACKED mode diverges from SINGLETON (a recall drop under packing), which is the specific regression the packing gate is designed to detect.
scenarios: A bug that makes the packing comparison always pass (e.g. candidate accidentally equals baseline) would not be caught
advisory.suggested_fix: Make the fake finder key on the number of blocks in the call (emit the conflict finding only when `len(blocks)==1`), then assert the packed candidate fails the comparative recall gate.
